movie.title: Ghost Market
movie.overview: Hidden away in a remote location on Oahu's North Shore is 'Ono Market, a plate lunch shop that serves lost spirits, stuck between life and death. The living have never set foot in this place - until a food-loving, would-be content creator named Kyle blunders in, eats a mixed plate for the dead, and accidentally turns himself into a half-ghost. To get back to normal, he'll have to deal with paranormal deliveries, long hours in a haunted kitchen, and scariest of all... his own family.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: After accidentally eating a meal meant for the dead at a hidden Oahu market, a food-obsessed content creator becomes half-ghost and must work off his debt alongside lost spirits to regain his humanity.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Stumbling upon 'Ono Market, a secret plate lunch shop on Oahu's North Shore catering to spirits stuck between life and death, aspiring content creator Kyle commits a grave mistake by eating food intended for the deceased. The mystical meal transforms him into a half-ghost, stranding him in the spectral realm. To reverse the curse, Kyle is forced to work at the shop, balancing supernatural deliveries with complex family dynamics back in the living world. Through his harrowing shifts, he learns that healing others' unresolved business might be the key to saving himself.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Kyle is an ambitious, food-loving creator searching for his next viral story when he accidentally stumbles off the beaten path on Oahu's North Shore. He finds 'Ono Market, an unassuming plate lunch joint hidden from the living world that exclusively feeds lingering souls awaiting passage to the afterlife. Unaware of the shop's true clientele, Kyle happily devours a mixed plate meant for a ghost, triggering an ancient magical rule that renders him half-spirit. Trapped in a phase between life and death, he is pressed into service by the shop's ethereal staff to earn back his full mortal existence. Kyle's new routine demands navigating high-stakes supernatural food deliveries across Hawaii's hidden realm and enduring grueling shifts in a haunted kitchen. Along the way, he interacts with diverse spirits, hearing their final regrets and uncovering the emotional weight behind their favorite comfort meals. Simultaneously, he must keep his spiraling double life hidden from his unsuspecting family, who notice his sudden, mysterious absence. Ultimately, Kyle comes to realize that his supernatural predicament is deeply tied to his own personal shortcomings and strained home life, forcing him to confront what truly matters before he loses his humanity forever.
aiEnrichment.synopsis:
'Ghost Market' follows Kyle, a food-obsessed aspiring content creator whose search for culinary hidden gems leads him straight into the supernatural realm. Tucked away on Oahu's North Shore sits 'Ono Market, a sanctuary where spirits lingering between life and death gather for one final, comforting plate lunch. When Kyle unknowingly wanders in and eats a meal tailored for the departed, he triggers a mystical transformation that leaves him half-ghost and unable to fully return to the living world.

To break the curse and regain his human form, Kyle must work off his debt at the spectral eatery. His new duties throw him into a world of chaotic kitchen prep, ghost-to-door deliveries, and unforgettable encounters with spirits clinging to their past lives. As he uncovers the stories behind the lost souls he serves, Kyle is forced to reflect on his own life, his priorities, and his relationship with his family. The series blends vibrant animation, Hawaiian culture, heartwarming family drama, and fantastical culinary adventures into a story about connection, memory, and the power of food.

story_structure.climax: A major crisis threatens both the closure of 'Ono Market and Kyle's final chance to return to normal, forcing him to face his deeply rooted family issues while risking everything to execute a critical delivery.
story_structure.conflict: Stuck between life and death, Kyle must find a way to restore his fully human form while navigating the strict rules of the supernatural market and keeping his situation hidden from his living family.
story_structure.resolution: Kyle completes his journey of personal growth, resolving his rift with his family and finding harmony between the living world and the spiritual realm as he secures his path back to normal.
story_structure.introduction: Kyle, an aspiring food content creator, accidentally stumbles into 'Ono Market—a hidden plate lunch shop on Oahu's North Shore catering to lost spirits. After eating a meal intended for the dead, he transforms into a half-ghost.
story_structure.risingAction: Kyle takes on long shifts in the haunted kitchen and executes high-stakes paranormal food deliveries across Oahu. As he works alongside supernatural staff, he deepens his understanding of the lost spirits' unfulfilled desires while balancing mounting pressure and emotional distance from his own family.
